articleTitle: MMC-DC/DC Converter and Its Control Strategy for Offshore Full DC Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The development trend for large-scale offshore wind farms in the future is offshore wind farms with complete DC, which can enhance wind power collecting and delivery efficiency and conserve resources on offshore platforms. It is also more appropriate for long-distance, high-capacity wind energy transmission. When building offshore full DC wind farms, one of the essential and fundamental pieces of equipment is the highvoltage, high-power delivery DC/DC converter. The research object in this paper is the modular multilevel high-voltage DC/DC converter. Two modular multilevel converters (MMC) are connected face-to-face, and control, voltage equalization, and modulation strategies are created. The MMC-DC/DC converter can be utilized on the output side of fully DC offshore wind farms and offers the benefits of flexible control and a high voltage carrying capability. Finally, to confirm the efficacy of the chosen topology and the entire control method, a simulation model is constructed using the Matlab/Simulink program.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Ferromagnetic Resonance of 10kV Electromagnetic Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Electromagnetic voltage transformers are usually used as measurement and protection devices in distribution networks with voltage levels of 10kV. The ferromagnetic resonance caused by the nonlinear characteristics of the excitation inductance of the electromagnetic voltage transformer is a common power system accident in the current power grid. Based on the Maxwell 3D module of ANSOFT software, this paper takes the JDZ10-10C1 voltage transformer as the reference model for modeling and simulation. The simulation results show the magnetic flux change of the voltage transformer core and the waveforms of overvoltage and inrush current when ferromagnetic resonance occurs. The amplitude-frequency characteristics of the excitation current are analyzed by Fourier transform. The simulation process further simulates the inductance change of voltage transformer under different voltage levels, which provides a reference for the selection of voltage transformer in engineering practice and has certain reference significance.

articleTitle: A Load Forecasting Method for Distribution Networks Considering the Influence of Photovoltaics and Traditional Load
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to address the impact of uncertainty in distributed photovoltaics on distribution network load forecasting, this paper proposes a distribution network load forecasting method that considers the impact of photovoltaics and traditional loads. Screen sample data for comprehensive load density indicators through grey correlation analysis. Calculate the correlation degree between the sample data and the load density index of the area to be predicted, and select the training data of the LS-SVM model based on the correlation degree as the standard for load density prediction. Taking the distribution network load data of a certain region for the past year as an example, compared with traditional technical solutions, the results show that the proposed method has significant advantages in load forecasting accuracy, error rate, stability, and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Optimizing CNN-LSTM Model for Short-term PV Power Prediction using Northern Goshawk Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: PV power is unstable and time-varying. In order to improve the accuracy and stability of PV power prediction, this paper proposes a short-term PV power prediction method based on the Northern Goshawk optimization algorithm (NGO)-optimized CNN-LSTM model. Firstly, the data were correlated using the Pearson correlation coefficient, and features with low correlation were eliminated. Then, the CNN-LSTM model was established, with the convolutional neural network (CNN) responsible for extracting the important features in the data, and the long-short term memory (LSTM) trained on the data. To further optimize the model, the NGO algorithm was introduced to optimize the hyperparameters such as the number of convolutional kernels, the step size of the pooling layer, and the number of neurons in the hidden layer of LSTM in the CNN-LSTM model, aiming to improve the prediction performance of the model. The prediction results show that the CNN-LSTM model optimized by NGO achieves higher accuracy compared to CNN-LSTM, SSA-CNN-LSTM, and other models, thereby providing technical support for grid scheduling and energy management.

articleTitle: Restoration Strategy for Honeycomb Active Distribution Network with Soft Open Point
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Honeycomb active distribution network is a new intelligent distribution network that adapts to the development of distribution networks in the future. Base smart power/information exchange station (SPIES) in the topology is connected to adjacent microgrids through multi-port power electronic switches, which can realize the flexible control. Because of this characteristic, honeycomb distribution network has stronger fault isolation and self-healing ability than traditional distribution network. Aiming at the fault recovery problem of the honeycomb distribution network with distributed photovoltaic, innovatively considered both island division and network reconstruction, proposed a power recovery strategy with SPIES. The optimal model was established with maximum recovery load and minimum network loss as the objective function, and a hybrid optimization algorithm of binary particle swarm optimization and second-order cone programming was used to solve the fault self-healing scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed strategy can effectively restore the power supply in the lost area of the honeycomb distribution network.

articleTitle: An Optimal Scheduling Strategy for Wind-PV and Multi-Type Energy Storage Co-Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Multi-type energy storage is essential for managing fluctuations in renewable energy power and increasing the consumption rate of renewable energy. In this paper, an optimal scheduling strategy for the co-generation system comprising wind power, photovoltaic power, electrical energy storage, and hydrogen energy storage is proposed. The strategy consists of a global optimization model and an application-oriented Pareto optimal solution screening methodology. The global optimization model establishes a multi-objective optimization model based on meteorological prediction information that considers the intended output power completion of the co-generation system, the remaining equivalent power of the energy storage plant, and the equivalent production of hydrogen. The NSGA-II is utilized to solve the global optimization model and obtains multiple Pareto optimal solutions. The optimal solutions are screened by applying the application-oriented Pareto optimal solution screening methodology. Finally, a co-generation plant in Shandong Province is presented to validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in mitigating wind variability and encouraging the adoption of renewable energy sources.

articleTitle: A Life Prediction Method for 10kV Vacuum Circuit Breakers Based on CNN-GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: As the core equipment of AC distribution network, the reliable operation of 10kV vacuum circuit breaker is closely related to the normal operation of the entire power grid. The 10kV vacuum circuit breaker achieves opening and closing operation through a complex and precise internal operating mechanism. Therefore, the health status of the mechanical components of the circuit breaker is the key to evaluating the operational reliability of the circuit breaker. This paper combines the traditional life prediction parameters of 10kV vacuum circuit breakers with a new artificial intelligence algorithm to propose a prediction method for the remaining life of 10kV vacuum circuit breakers based on CNN-GRU. Firstly, the Pearson correlation coefficient method is used to select the key characteristic parameters that affect the life of the 10kV vacuum circuit breaker. Subsequently, more abstract characteristics were screened and extracted from these key characteristics using CNN algorithms. Finally, these extracted characteristics are input into the GRU neural network for life prediction, and the accuracy of the prediction is continuously improved through training the model. The final training results show that the accuracy of the prediction results of the algorithm model reaches over 95%, proving the feasibility of the algorithm model for predicting the remaining life of 10kV vacuum circuit breakers in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Improved Double-Loop Control Strategy for Three-Phase Inverter With Unbalanced Load
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Symmetry of three-phase output voltage is one of the essential requirements for three-phase inverter. Conventional double-loop control strategy has a good control effect on the output voltage waveform during load balancing. But in case of load imbalance, the output voltage contains negative sequence component, which cannot achieve three-phase inverter output voltage balance. Therefore, this article proposes an improved double-loop control strategy that decomposes the output unbalanced voltage into positive and negative sequence component, and then controls the positive and negative sequence component separately in the dual synchronous rotating coordinate system, so that the negative sequence component tracks the zero reference voltage without static difference, effectively improving the ability of the three-phase inverter to carry unbalanced loads. The simulation and experimental results verify the correctness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Large-Disturbance Stability Analysis of Flexible Interconnected System of Distribution Areas Considering Load-Balancing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the proposal of the “dual-carbon” target and the rapid development of distributed generation technology, distribution areas (DAs) are faced with the problems of difficult to expand capacity, difficult to consume distributed generation, unable to effectively use the remaining capacity of each DA, etc. The flexible interconnection system (FIS) has gradually become a solution to improve the power supply level of DAs. To fully utilize the advantages of the flexible power flow control of FIS, a $v_{\mathrm {{dc}}}-P_{\mathrm {{grid}}}$ droop control strategy is proposed, which takes into account load balancing. This strategy balances the AC source output of each DA during normal operation. Subsequently, a simplified circuit model of the system is developed, and the stability of the system is analyzed under large disturbances when a constant power load is connected to the DC bus, using the mixed potential function theory. The stability criteria of the system is obtained, and verified by the real-time hardware-in-loop (HIL) tests.

articleTitle: Research on Phase Identification Technology of Power Supply District Based on High Frequency Collection Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: At present, the HPLC (High-speed Power Line Carrier)-based power supply district identification technology is not mature and the unreliable, which is far from meeting the practical needs of power supply companies. Therefore, this paper takes an power-supplied area as an example, and establishes a feature extraction algorithm through analysis of high frequency acquisition data. Through K-Means clustering algorithm, we analyze the relationship between households in the power supply district and build up a model for analyzing the relationship between households in the power supply district; through deep data mining, we combine the longitudinal conduction characteristics of the current in the power supply district and build up a model for analyzing the phase of power supply in the power supply district. By running the above models, the power supply phase identification of smart energy meter is realized, which meets the business requirements of power supply company.

articleTitle: Hybrid Synchronous Control Based Voltage Unbalance Compensation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: As the penetration of distributed energy sources is increasing, the stability pattern of the power systems becomes more complex, and they also face the risk of desynchronization and harmonic disturbances when facing large disturbances or asymmetric operating conditions. It is important to analyze and improve the flexible interconnected system to maintain the symmetric and stable operation of voltage even under large asymmetric disturbances. This article proposes a kind of voltage unbalance compensation theory with hybrid synchronous control, construct a voltage unbalance compensation model in accordance with the reactive power compensation principle, and then proves the validity of the suggested control approach through simulation.

articleTitle: Order Reduction Method for Doubly-fed Induction Generator Impedance/Admittance Model Based on Singular Perturbation Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of wind power generation, the penetration of large wind farms in the power grid has increased significantly. A large-scale wind farm contains dozens or hundreds of wind turbines, the model order is high, the modeling analysis is difficult, and the analysis needs to be effectively reduced. In this paper, a singular perturbation theory reduction method for impedance/admittance model stability analysis of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) is proposed. Firstly, the state space model under the working point of the DFIG model is obtained by using the LINMOD function of MATLAB, and then the state variables of the model’s state space equation can be analyzed on the fast and slow time scale, so as to reduce the order of singular perturbation theory. At the same time, the state space model after order reduction is transformed into impedance/admittance model. The model before and after order reduction has good consistency, and can be used for stability analysis of the system.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Entrance Characterization Signal of Diversified Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: KDS (Diversified Drive System), as the backup of the RPS (Reactor Protection System), should deal with the RPS software CCF (Common Cause Failure) superimposed on the DBC (Design Basis Condition) while alleviating the consequences of the ATWT (Anticipated Transient Without Trip). Through in-depth analysis of KDS accident operation guidelines and RPS failure causes, it is found that the existing KDS entrance characterization will not be generated when only RPS failure and no DBC occurs, and the operator cannot be informed of the failure of the RPS at the first time. Based on the function principle and application scenario of BEEP function block, this paper determines the fault diagnosis method of RPS equipment, and proposes an optimized design of KDS entrance characterization signal. The results show that the design can cope with the failure of individual RPS, allowing operators to intervene with the unit earlier, without waiting for DBC to occur before taking action.

articleTitle: A New Model of Automatic Repowering Management Based on Distributed Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to closely implement the headquarters strategy of constructing excellent service engineering and continuously improving service efficiency proposed by State Grid, and comprehensively improve the time efficiency of users’ electricity consumption after payment of bills, based on intelligent electricity meters, and based on the active power restoration (automatic restoration after tripping) function of remote fee-control electricity meters, and through the optimization and upgrading of the digitized business processes of the two sets of systems of electric power marketing and power consumption collection, the Company explored and constructed a new mode of power restoration management based on the distributed architecture and carried out a pilot application. By optimizing and upgrading the digital business processes of the two systems of power marketing and power consumption collection, we explore the construction of a new model of power restoration management based on distributed architecture and carry out pilot applications to realize the restoration of power delivery within 2 hours after the user pays the fee. This paper firstly analyzes the working principle of traditional power outage and restoration, and then introduces the new mode of management based on distributed architecture and the realization of business process transformation in the two systems. Finally, the application effectiveness potential of the new model is described and further research directions are proposed.

articleTitle: The Effect of Pulse Rising Edge on the Electrical Tree Growth Characteristics of Epoxy Resin at High-Frequency Square Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the advancement of power electronics, power electronic devices need to bear the operating conditions of pulse width modulation (PWM) voltage with higher frequencies, higher amplitudes, and steeper pulse rising edges. Epoxy resin is extensively applied to packaging insulation materials due to its significant performance. However, its insulation performance under different pulse parameters of higher-frequency PWM waves still needs further research. This article compares and investigates the effect of different pulse rise times on the electrical tree growth characteristics of epoxy resin under the action of low-frequency and high-frequency PWM waves. Research has found that high frequency can promote the growth of electrical tree. Under the action of a unipolar square wave with an amplitude of 12 kV at room temperature, the growth rate of the epoxy resin electrical tree significantly increases when the frequency rises from 400 Hz to 10 kHz. At high frequency, both the horizontal and vertical growth rates of the electrical tree exhibit a nonlinear growing trend. Meanwhile, the pulse rise time has a significant impact on the morphology of the electrical tree. At low and high frequencies, there is a significant difference in the morphology of the electrical tree of epoxy resin as the pulse rise time increases. However, overall, the width of the electrical tree channel decreases bit by bit, and the color of the channel becomes lighter.

articleTitle: Data Governance Method and Application for Agency Power Purchase Business
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Agency power purchase refers to the role of power supply enterprises acting as user agent service providers, purchasing the electricity required by users from the electricity trading platform at market prices, and settling electricity fees according to the monthly published agency electricity purchase price. As an important part of promoting the marketization of electricity, agency power purchase can promote the high-quality development of the power industry and support the construction of new power systems. In order to normalize the agency power purchase business and ensure the smooth operation of the power purchase mechanism, taking the data of Jiangsu Province from 2013 to 2022 as the indicator, a data governance method for the agency power purchase business is proposed, which predicts the data and analyzes the deviation rate, so as to realize multi-source data fusion governance, and approve the monthly electricity, daily electricity, time-based electricity and load data to ensure that the average monthly forecast accuracy rate reaches 95% or more, realize dynamic monitoring and analysis of key users, and ensure the steady progress and accurate implementation of the agency power purchase business.

articleTitle: An adaptive Power Control of Photovoltaic Virtual Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Generally, photovoltaic grid-connected systems based on maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control need to be configured with a certain energy storage device to enhance the ability to support the stable operation of the power grid, which will increase project investment and maintenance costs, and virtual synchronous machines provides a solution for photovoltaic power to connect to the grid by simulating inertia and damping. Therefore, a control strategy of two-stage PV virtual synchronous generator without energy storage is proposed. This method adds DC bus voltage control to the MPPT control method of traditional photovoltaic systems, achieving adaptive matching of photovoltaic power to the load with an improved VSG control, and avoiding the phenomenon of light abandonment. When the photovoltaic power is sufficient, the system adopts DC bus voltage control strategy. When the PV power is insufficient, the system adopts the MPPT control and realizes the DC voltage stability through VSG control. At the same time, the method can also realize the operation of the photovoltaic system in grid-connected and off-grid. The simulation results show that this method has good dynamic and stable performance, and provides certain inertia and damping support for PV grid connection without adding energy storage equipment.

articleTitle: Design of a Low Temperature Drift On-Chip Power Supply Module Circuit with Nonlinear Temperature Curvature Compensation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Low-dropout regulators (LDOs) are an important part of power management integrated circuits (PMICs). Due to the IC chip’s heat generation and ambient temperature changes, etc., the chip is usually operated at changing temperatures, which requires the LDO to ensure output voltage consistency over a wide temperature range. As the LDO output voltage reference source, in order to get smaller reference voltage variation with the temperature change, bandgap reference needs to eliminate the non-linear relationship between output voltage and temperature. Additionally, the bandgap reference should also have a high power supply rejection ratio. In this paper, a compensation circuit is developed for bandgap reference based on a transconductance amplifier with a high power supply rejection ratio, and a nonlinear temperature drift compensation current is generated and injected. As a result, the insensitivity of the bandgap reference voltage to the temperature is significantly improved by injecting this compensation current into the low-current-density terminal transistor of the bandgap reference, and a temperature coefficient of 2.733ppm/°C is realized. Based on this, an LDO power supply module is designed, which is proven to have good performance by simulation, and can be used as the internal power supply module of PMIC.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization Control of hourly Intelligent Charging Stations using Photovoltaic Generation and Load Demand Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy and the increasing demand for clean energy, the integrated photovoltaic storage charging station, as an important part of the energy system, is receiving increasing attention. This study aims to realize the intelligent energy optimization control of the energy storage system by combining photovoltaic power generation and charging load prediction, so as to maximize the energy utilization efficiency and economic benefits of the charging station. Firstly, this paper introduces the basic composition of the integrated photovoltaic storage charging station. Subsequently, an energy optimization control strategy based on PV power generation and load demand prediction is proposed. Through the accurate prediction of PV power generation, the system can adjust the energy storage and distribution strategy in advance. At the same time, combined with the charging load power prediction, the optimal scheduling of the energy storage system is realized to improve the energy utilization efficiency and maximize the net benefit of the charging station site. The experimental results show that by making full use of photovoltaic power generation and charging load prediction, and reasonably scheduling the power of the energy storage system, the charging station can achieve a better balance between energy supply and demand, thus maximizing the energy utilization efficiency and economic benefits, and providing useful guidance and reference for the future development of sustainable energy.

articleTitle: Sagging Control Method of Parallel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The line impedance in the low-voltage microgrid is non-inductive, and when the multi-inverter power supply is operated in parallel, there is a strong coupling between the active power and the reactive power and the uneven distribution of reactive power due to the mismatch between the line impedance and the distributed power capacity. An improved droop control strategy based on adaptive virtual inductance is proposed, and the traditional droop control principle, power distribution characteristics, and circulation causes are analyzed. This article then explains the improved droop control strategy, where virtual inductors enable power decoupling of traditional droop control. Virtual inductance is optimized to improve adaptive virtual inductance to compensate for voltage dips caused by the introduction of virtual inductance.

articleTitle: Enhancing Short-term Electric Load Forecasting with EMD-GA Optimized LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: To enhance the accuracy of load forecasting, this paper considers both the inherent patterns within historical load data and external influencing factors. A short-term load forecasting approach is proposed that combines Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Genetic Algorithm (GA), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Inputs include weather conditions, temperature, hourly weights, and date weights, while load data is the output. Historical data from a building in an industrial park in the Wuhan region is utilized as the dataset. Various prediction models are compared, including Back Propagation Neural Network (BP), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Random Forest (RF), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The evaluation metrics (MAE, RMSE, R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) indicate that LSTM outperforms the others. To further enhance the LSTM model, Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) is introduced for data preprocessing, and Genetic Algorithm (GA) is employed to optimize LSTM’s hyperparameters. The results show that the EMD-GA-LSTM model achieves the best performance in load forecasting with MAE, RMSE, and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> values of 6.18, 7.31, and 0.994, respectively, which are better than the other compared methods.

articleTitle: Control Parameter Identification for DFIG based on RFE-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Aiming to establish the accurate model of doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) to analyze the grid-connected dynamic characteristic, an identification method of control parameters for DFIG based on recursive feature elimination (RFE) and bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the response data sets of real DFIG controller are obtained based on RT-LAB platform, which provides the data reference for the parameter identification. Secondly, RFE-BiLSTM is adopted to identify the control parameters of DFIG. Compared with LSTM and BiLSTM methods, the proposed RFE-BiLSTM DFIG method not only has the lowest identification error, but also has the best adaptability to multiple working conditions.

articleTitle: An Adaptive MTPA Control Method based on improved EKO for PMa-SynRM Drive System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The maximum torque per ampere (MTPA) control is usually used to achieve optimal control of energy efficiency of electric vehicles (EVs). However, the MTPA control strategy depends heavily on the motor model and parameters. The EVs are affected by temperature change, magnetic saturation and other factors during operation, which will lead to deterioration of MTPA control performance. Therefore, an adaptive MTPA control method based on improved extended Kalman observer (EKO) for permanent-magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor (PMa-SynRM) drive system is proposed. By establishing the equivalent model of PMa-SynRM with iron loss, an improved extended Kalman filter algorithm based on d-axis current zeroing is proposed. This algorithm can estimate the iron loss and inductance parameters of the motor on the line, and the MTPA control parameters can be corrected in real time to optimize the stator current vector. The simulation results show that the proposed method has fast convergence speed, high parameter identification accuracy, and improves the MTPA control performance in case of parameter mismatch.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet assisted synchronous reluctance motor (PMa-SynRM)

articleTitle: A Design and Implementation of Real-Time Abnormal Detection Platform based on Power Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a design and implementation of a real-time anomaly warning platform based on power monitoring data for the problem of anomaly warning of monitoring data in the power system. The platform uses the Electron framework to implement the three-dimensional display of power nodes. It collects and stores power monitoring data, classifies the monitoring data using the decision tree classification algorithm, and combines with the temporal features to further verify the classification and anomaly detection situations, realizing real-time monitoring and warning of abnormal conditions in the power system. Experimental results show that the platform system has good intuitiveness and completeness, and has good performance in terms of accuracy and real-time implementation of classification warning functions, which can provide strong support for the safe operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Graph Computing-Based Energy Storage Profit Optimization Considering Market Participant
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In modern power systems, energy storage has become increasingly vital. Energy storage balances the temporal and seasonal fluctuations in the power grid, ensuring electricity availability during peak demand and enhancing the system’s reliability during emergencies, such as power outages or unexpected increases in load. However, operating energy storage systems comes with relatively high costs, encompassing the procurement and maintenance of storage devices. This paper introduced a graph model of profit-maximizing energy storage optimization that takes market participation into account. It defined nodes in the physical power grid and optimization computation graph models. The proposed approach included various constraints, such as storage capacity, charging and discharging power limits, and energy exchange balance within the energy storage system’s electrical grid. This methodology enabled swift calculations to attain strategies that maximize energy storage profits by leveraging graph computing.

articleTitle: Research on Reliability Investment of Distribution Network Considering Power Grid Remote Control Terminal
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the intervention of distribution terminals, the reliability of power supply and automation level of the distribution network has improved significantly compared to the pre-intervention level. However the traditional distribution automation system is less introduced due to the expensive price of the three remote terminals, which limits the improvement of distribution network reliability. In order to address the above issues, this paper presents a methodology for reliability investment in distribution networks involving mobile control terminals. Optimal economic investment for hybrid arrangement of remote control terminals in distribution networks subject to reliability constraints. The RBTS BUS2 example is used to illustrate the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Beidou High-Precision Positioning Algorithm and Verification Applied to Power Tower Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Based on the Beidou foundation enhancement technology, this article utilizes the Beidou high-precision positioning algorithm to obtain the three-dimensional position changes of the power grid iron tower. It can remotely and real-time monitor the tilt deformation of the tower body and the settlement displacement of the tower foundation, solving the problem of poor real-time performance of traditional sensors and inability to obtain the absolute position changes of the iron tower in the three-dimensional coordinate space. It can effectively predict the health status of the iron tower and prevent the occurrence of tower tilt or settlement accidents, Effectively avoiding power losses and human casualties. By analyzing actual measurement data and using Beidou navigation data to detect the position data of power tower, the accuracy can reach millimeter level.

articleTitle: Cost Analysis of Energy Storage Systems Participating in Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulation Auxiliary Services
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In the context of large-scale new energy resources being connected to the power grid, the participation of energy storage in the power auxiliary service market can effectively improve the safety and stability of power grid operation. In order to quantitatively analyze the cost of energy storage participating in the power auxiliary service market, this paper uses the life cycle cost theory to quantitatively model the cost of energy storage participating in the power auxiliary service market. Then, the life cycle cost driver of energy storage is analyzed through the cost disturbance factor analysis model, and the influence degree of each cost factor on the life cycle cost is obtained. Finally, a practical example is given to verify that the proposed method can effectively estimate the cost of energy storage participating in the auxiliary service market and analyze the disturbance factors of cost changes, which can provide a reference for the subsequent proposal of the trading mechanism of energy storage participating in the auxiliary service.

articleTitle: Research on Long-Term Electricity Demand Forecasting Based on WOA-BP
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Power supply and demand balance is a vital prerequisite for boosting economic development and raising people’s living standards, and precise forecasting of power demand is the cornerstone for guaranteeing power supply and demand balance. Reasonable and accurate power demand forecast plays an important role in guiding the planning and development of power industry. Therefore, this paper takes the power consumption of the whole society as the representative of the power demands as the research objective, selects the influential factors that may affect the power consumption from multiple angles, and uses the grey correlation degree to analyze the influence degree, and the factors with greater influence in the whole region as the predictive dependent variable. Then, the back propagation neural network optimized by the whale algorithm is used to train the model through the screened data and predict the future electricity consumption of the whole society. Then, an empirical model analysis is carried out with the whole society electricity consumption of a province in East China as the research object, which proves that the prediction effect of the model is good, and the prediction results provide a basis for the future power planning and development of the province.

articleTitle: Pressure Control System of Cruise Engine Room Based on BP Neural Network PID
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to achieve accurate and stable control of cruise engine room air pressure, Comsol builds a room simulation model of cruise engine room, and then systematically identifies the mathematical model between fan speed and air pressure. Finally, aiming at the nonlinear, parameter time variability and time delay problems of cruise air pressure control system, The direction propagation neural network combined with conventional proportional integral and differential is proposed to control the temperature and pressure of the cruise engine room. BP neural network PID controller is designed, and the parameters of conventional PID controller are automatically adjusted online by using the online self-learning ability of BP neural network. Simulink model is built for simulation and verification. Compared with conventional PID control and fuzzy PID control, the response time of BP neural network PID control is shortened by 76.47% and the overshoot is reduced by 4.8% compared with fuzzy PID control. Compared with conventional PID control and fuzzy PID control, BP neural network PID adjustment time and overshoot are reduced, its dynamic response ability is improved, and it shows better adaptive ability.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Design of the Current-limiting Control Strategy Based on Voltage Source Operation of Energy Storage Inverters
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the increase in the penetration rate of new energy sources into the grid, the voltage of distribution networks in some areas is susceptible to disturbances, leading to a decrease in grid robustness. Energy storage can effectively mitigate the fluctuations of new energy sources. When energy storage inverters are connected to weak grids, they can operate in voltage-source mode to enhance grid characteristics. However, in this case, the ability of current control decreases. There is a risk of overcurrent issues during the switching of high-power loads. Therefore, current limiting control is needed. When applying the current limiter to inverters operated in voltage-source mode, it can lead to voltage desynchronization, causing instability. Thus, this paper proposes a current limiting control strategy based on phase angle switching for energy storage inverters operated in voltage-source mode. Taking the droop control as an example, this paper compares the current-limiting strategy based on virtual impedance with the current-limiting strategy based on phase angle switching. From simulation results, this paper demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: energy storage inverter with voltage source operation

articleTitle: An Application Study on the Innovative Design of Electric Energy Saving for Different Heating Covers
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The entry point of this research is to reduce energy demand through different hardware designs and changes in power management control. In the future, better energy saving effects and power control can be achieved by adding closed energy saving to the control of the power management system. Improve power usage efficiency. Comparative research on energy consumption of different heating methods aims to evaluate various methods in energy utilization. The energy consumption of different heating methods must also be based on the use of different insulation materials. Electric heating is a common form of heating, including the efficiency of the heating device, how long it has been used, and the source of electricity used. In addition, the comparison of different heating food surface insulation materials shows that in the cooking and food industry, insulation is a crucial factor to ensure that hot food is maintained at the appropriate temperature after preparation to ensure quality and safety. Different insulation materials can be used to achieve this goal, and each material has its own unique advantages and limitations. This research will use an innovative design to use different appearance material changes and power management feedback mechanisms, and then change the design and materials of different insulation surfaces under the same heating conditions through the power input of general household electricity (110V). The use of it can significantly reduce energy consumption and required heating power and achieve energy-saving effects, providing a reference for future innovative designs of energy conservation and carbon reduction.

articleTitle: A New State Estimation Method for Distribution Network with High Penetrated Renewable Energy Considering Extreme Weather Impact
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the high proportion of distributed photovoltaic (PV) connected to the distribution network, the conventional static state estimation based on data acquisition and monitoring system can no longer meet the requirements of advanced applications in the distribution management system. Considering the changes in distribution network characteristics after high proportion of PV integration. This proposes two state estimation methods - a static robust one based on generalized maximum likelihood estimation and a dynamic one with two parameters.

articleTitle: Low-Frequency Control Strategy for a Modified Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In low-frequency conditions, the submodule capacitor voltage of Modular Multilevel Converters (MMC) inevitably experiences intense fluctuations. Using the high-frequency injection method to suppress capacitor voltage fluctuations in conventional MMC topologies results in the undesired introduction of common-mode voltages. This paper focuses on a modified MMC based on a middle submodule, achieving suppression of submodule capacitor voltage fluctuations under high-frequency injection and eliminating the introduction of common-mode voltages on the AC side. Moreover, by optimizing the high-frequency injection method, the bridge arm current is reduced, thereby decreasing switching stress and losses. Simulation results confirmed the stated conclusions.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of Fault Interaction Effects Between the Positive and Negative Poles in Bipolar MMC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Modular multilevel converter (MMC) based high-voltage direct current (HVDC) is an effective solution for achieving large-scale coordination, complementarity, and reliable transmission of renewable energy, and is an important application direction for future high-voltage and large-capacity DC transmission. However, at the DC side of the bipolar VSC-HVDC system, if the pole-to-ground fault occurs in one pole, it will not only lead to the rapid rise of fault current that may damage the power electronic devices, but also affect the operation of the other pole. Therefore, it is of great importance to investigate the characteristics of the pole-to-ground fault at DC side and the mechanism of fault interaction effects between two poles. In this paper, the operation principle of the MMC and the bipolar VSCHVDC system are introduced firstly. Then, the characteristics of the pole-to-ground fault are analysed and the interaction effects is studied. Finally, the fault characteristics and mechanism of interaction effects are verified by electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulations.

articleTitle: Flexible Loads Participate in Distributed Trading Market Research
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: With the continuous development of Chinese electricity market reform and opening the distributed transaction market, allowing multi-players such as load-side resources to participate in market competition has become a new trend in the development of Chinese electricity market. The participation of flexible loads in the distributed transaction market can effectively improve on the utilization rate of renewable energy, absorb wind power, reduce the operation and electricity costs of market members, ensure the safety of the power grid, and reduce the impact of distributed power sources on the power grid. In this paper, the interaction model including three types of flexible loads in power systems are established firstly, and then the distributed transaction mechanism is established according to the existing market environment. The example cases are based on a day’s transaction in a certain area, and the results show that the interaction of flexible load can effectively achieve peak cutting and valley filling and absorb new energy output.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of China’s New Power System Construction Policy based on Policy Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Since the concept of the new power system was proposed, China has introduced a series of policies to promote the construction of the new power system. This paper makes a quantitative analysis of the policies from the two dimensions of policy tools and policy objects, revealing the shortcomings of the existing policy tools. With 87 national and local policy documents focusing on the construction of new power systems as samples, this paper adopts the content analysis method and quantifies the sample policies from the two dimensions of basic policy tools and policy objects according to the steps of analysis framework construction, analysis unit delineation and frequency statistical analysis. It is found that the structure of policy tools in the construction of new power system in China is not balanced, and there are over-spill risks and crowding out effects.

articleTitle: Energy Storage Sizing for IES Considering Carbon Trading and Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: An optimal energy storage sizing method for integrated energy system (IES) considering carbon trading and demand response is presented in this paper. Firstly, to effectively limit carbon emissions, a reward-penalty laddered carbon trading model is designed to convert carbon emissions into system costs or revenues. Secondly, the integrated demand response (IDR) model for electrical-cold-heat loads is established based on time-of-use price to enhance the operational flexibility and economy. Then, based on these two sub-models, an optimal energy storage sizing model is built to minimize the total life cycle cost including investment, operation and carbon trading cost. Finally, the simulation results indicate that a successful balance between low-carbon and economy can be achieved by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on A New Type of Low Current Grounding System Based on Arc Suppression Coil
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: China’s power distribution network covers a wide range, the structure is complex and changeable, and random faults often occur. The neutral ground mode plays a decisive role in fault discovery and process as well as the operation of distribution network. This paper discusses a new type of low current grounding system that uses arc suppression coil parallel resistance grounding, which can satisfy the problems of eliminating arc and fast line selection and tripping at the same time and verifies the characteristics of this grounding system through simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Data Migration Method Based on Electric Power Marketing Service System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Power marketing service system data migration is the process of transferring data from the existing power marketing service system to the new marketing service system. This topic analyzes the data model and sorts out the scope of data migration, and reversely verifies the integrity, accuracy, and availability of the migrated data based on business scenarios. According to the three-step method of “migration, verification, and defect elimination”, estimate migration resources, optimize migration script performance, comprehensively evaluate data distribution and storage conditions, optimize migration scheduling tasks, and realize “automatic, one-click” data migration, which improves the system data migration efficiency minimizes technical and social risks, and ensures the smooth launch and operation of the marketing service system.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Route and Application of the Construction of Ultra-high Voltage Digital Station
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: At present, the digital construction of converter station and ultra-high voltage substation has become the focus of electric power digitalization in the new era, and how to combine advanced technical means to achieve digital station construction is a way to explore. Based on the construction experience of the current digital pilot station, this paper explores the construction scheme and technology of the digital station, discusses the pain points and difficulties in the construction process, points out the goals and directions of future construction, and plays a certain reference for the promotion, optimization and upgrading of the digital station.

articleTitle: Study on Full-Size Fire Extinguishing Experimental Conditions of Main Transformer in UHV Substation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In the operation process of UHV substation, the fire accident risk of UHV AC transformer is large. If the fire accident occurs in UHV transformer, it will seriously affect the safe operation of power grid. Full-scale fire extinguishing experiment is an important method to verify the effectiveness of fire extinguishing system and determine the parameters of fire extinguishing system. The scientificity of the experimental scheme will directly determine whether reliable and effective experimental data and results can be obtained. In this paper, the full-scale fire extinguishing experimental conditions of the main transformer in UHV substation will be studied to ensure that the fire characteristics, boundary conditions, adverse working conditions and key fire parameters of the experimental simulation are close to the real fire scene.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence of Rotor Eccentricity in Double Fed Induction Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Rotor eccentricity is a common fault in doubly fed induction machines (DFIMs) after long-term operation and bearing aging, which causes uneven air gap thus leading to unbalanced magnetic tension as well as additional vibration and noise. This paper provides a detailed analysis of the impact of rotor eccentricity on the DFIM’s operational performance. The analytical expression of radial electromagnetic force under rotor eccentricity is established, and verified using finite element model. The results indicate that both static and dynamic eccentricity can enrich the harmonic content of radial electromagnetic force, generate odd order force waves, and increase motor vibration and torque ripple. When the eccentricity increases, the indicators are further deteriorate.

articleTitle: Research on Resistance Current Forecast Model of Lightning Arrester Based on VMD-ELM-AEFA Combination
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Metal Oxide Varistor (MOV) is an overvoltage protection device used in power systems, as well as in electronic devices. They can quickly change the resistance when the voltage exceeds its rated value, dispersing overvoltage energy into thermal energy, thereby protecting other components in the circuit from damage. In power systems, MOV lightning arresters are typically used to protect equipment from lightning strikes, grid disturbances, or other voltage surges. In this context, a lightning arrester resistive current prediction model based on the combination of VMD-ELM-AEFA is proposed to determine the cracking trend of MOA. Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) can effectively extract the intrinsic trend of resistive current, reduce sequence nonlinearity, and combine it with the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) model optimized by the Artificial Potential Field Algorithm (AEFA) to greatly improve the accuracy compared to the model before decomposition, The prediction of resistive current has great guiding significance.

articleTitle: Design of a Wide Input Power Dual-Frequency Rectifying Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: A Hilbert dual-frequency rectifying antenna is proposed to harvest RF energy in space environment, which can recover wireless energy effectively. The rectifier circuit consists of impedance matching network, Cockcroft-walton voltage doubling rectifier circuit and DC-pass filter. The receiving antenna adopts the symmetrical dipole antenna mode, and the main body is composed of Hilbert fractal structure and helical structure to ensure the omnidirectional antenna radiation. Antenna operating center frequencies are 0.94GHz and 2.45GHz. The impedance matching network is designed based on $\lambda$/4 dual-frequency coupler, which can reduce RF signal reflection and improve energy utilization efficiency. The rectifier circuit uses HMSS-2852 Schottky diodes with low starting conditions and suitable for ambient RF energy with low energy density. The rectifier topology adopts Cockcroft-walton voltage doubling rectifier circuit which has the highest rectifier efficiency at the operating frequency. DC-pass filter adopts fan stub structure to suppress fundamental wave and high order harmonics and improve the efficiency of RF energy rectification. ADS simulation results show that the maximum rectifying efficiency of the rectifying antenna at 0.94GHz and 2.4GHz are 70.84% and 56.77%, respectively. At the 0.94GHz and 2.4GHz frequencies, In the wide input power range of -4.4dBm $\sim$ 17.4dBm and 2.4dBm $\sim$ 16.8dBm, the rectification efficiency is greater than 40%. The rectifier circuit has the characteristics of dual-frequency and wide input power, which can be applied to power to low-power devices such as wireless sensors.

articleTitle: Cooperative Energy Optimization for Multiple Diversified Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The traditional energy system has the problems of low rate of renewable energy consumption and energy utilization, and the integrated energy system (IES) comes into being to achieve the optimal utilization of energy through multi-energy complementation. Up until now, most of IES studies focus on single type IES. This paper proposes a cooperative energy optimization strategy based on muti-community IESs, which fully considers the user’s demand response of multiple energy. A cooperative energy trading market is considered in the proposed method, where each IES can purchase energy from other IESs or sell energy to other IES when it experiences a supply-demand imbalance. Numerical simulations are carried out to show our proposal for each IES that participates in the cooperative energy market and reduces carbon emissions compared with the non-cooperative market.

articleTitle: A Review of Hydraulic and Mechanical Vibration Characteristics of Pumped Storage Units
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of hydropower units is the key to realize the effective support of hydropower units to the new power grid. At present, the research on unit vibration mainly focuses on electromagnetic vibration, and there is a lack of systematic review on vibration caused by hydraulic and mechanical factors. Therefore, this paper aims to provide a comprehensive review by systematically sorting out the characteristics and suppression methods of unit system vibration. Firstly, it is classified according to the vibration source, and the generation mechanism of hydraulic vibration and mechanical vibration is analyzed respectively. And the multi-dimensional comparison of different vibration sources is made, and the suppression measures are discussed. Secondly, the current methods for the measurement and suppression of hydraulic vibration and mechanical vibration are reviewed. Finally, the research status and future development direction of vibration and stability are summarized.

articleTitle: Lightning Arrester Status Evaluation based on Defect Data Mining and 1D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to accurately judge and analyze the operating status of distribution network lightning arresters. Unlike state analysis that predicts temporal data and sets relevant thresholds, this article uses atomic clustering and hierarchical clustering algorithms to mine lightning arrester defect data from equipment operation data to eliminate interference from related operation data and reduce the requirement of excessive data volume. Secondly, an adaptive encoding and decoding framework is used to reduce the overall data and extract features, And set it as the input of a state classification model based on one-dimensional convolutional neural networks. By effectively mining defect data of lightning arresters and using 1D-CNN models, the defect status of lightning arresters can be identified. The experimental results demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of data mining and automatic encoder, as well as the accuracy and timeliness of the 1D-CNN state evaluation model.

articleTitle: A Hybird Synchronous Rectification Scheme with Independent Turn-on and Turn-off Timing Control for SiC-Based CLLC Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid synchronous rectification (SR) scheme for CLLC resonant converters. By combining phase tracking and current-based SR advantages, the scheme achieves separate control of turn-on and turn-off timings. The turn-on timing is determined by analyzing the maximum phase shift between primary-side voltage and secondary-side resonant current across the converter’s operating range using a fundamental approximation model (FHA) and simulations. Turn-off timing relies on comparing the SR current with a predefined threshold. Experimental results from a 6.6 kW prototype validate its reliability and stability. With the adoption of this scheme, CLLC converter efficiency is improved, and a higher SR MOSFET conduction ratio is achieved, ensuring reliable and stable SR control in various modes.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Data Assimilation Technology for New Energy Power Generation Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In the high proportion of new energy power system, wind power, photovoltaic and other power generation methods are more affected by geographical and meteorological conditions, there is a large volatility and meteorological elements on the power system influence is becoming more and more prominent. Considering the influence of the sea-air-wave coupling process, this paper establishes a double-nested numerical weather prediction system based on multi-source real-time ocean-atmosphere observations and refined numerical prediction models by studying the construction and operation techniques of the offshore wind resource forecasting model to enhance the forecast accuracy of atmospheric elements, and realizes the refined forecast of wind resource forecasting by using the micro-meteorological scale model. Meanwhile, the ground-based solar irradiance technology based on the atmospheric radiation transport model is studied, and a gridded in situ forecast model of light resources is constructed to realize the refined forecast of solar irradiance. Based on more accurate meteorological forecast data, it provides strong support for new energy power generation prediction, improves the accuracy of new energy power generation prediction, promotes the consumption of new energy, and guarantees the safe and stable operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Short-Term Power Load Forecasting Based on ISHO-ELM
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of large prediction errors in existing power load forecasting methods, a short-term power load forecasting model based on improved spotted hyena algorithm optimized-extreme learning machine (ISHO-ELM) is proposed. Firstly, the quasi-inverse learning strategy and elite strategy are introduced into the spotted hyena optimization algorithm to improve the search capability of the algorithm, and the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified by the benchmark function. Secondly, using the algorithm of ISHO optimization of ELM random parameters in order to improve the prediction accuracy and stability of the model. Lastly, the advancement and practicability of the constructed short-term power load forecasting model are verified by the actual measurement data. The results show that the fitting coefficients of the proposed ISHOELM model are 1.6% and 1.7% higher than those of the existing ELM and SVM models, respectively. This study is of great significance to improve the stability of power system operation.

articleTitle: Energy-saving Optimization of Train Timetable Based on Regenerative Energy Utilization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The development of urban rail transit systems has concentrated on low-carbon development, energy conservation, and preservation of the environment, and one of the key strategies to maximize the energy savings of the urban rail systems is to optimize the train operation process. In order to further reduce the energy consumption of train operation, the schedule can be adjusted to better match the various train traction and braking processes in the same power supply interval. This also promotes the absorption and usage of regenerative braking energy (RBE). In this paper, the energy-saving optimization problem of periodic (flat peak period) timetables is studied. The particle swarm optimization approach is utilized to solve the schedule optimization model, which is built utilizing the controllability of train departure interval and stop time. According to the simulation results, the modified train timetable’s regenerative energy utilization rate has grown to 7.84%, which has a positive impact on energy conservation.

Author Keywords: Urban rail transit timetable energy-saving optimization multi-vehicle collaboration

articleTitle: Research on Load State Identification Method Based on CNN-Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Load monitoring is a critical link in the development of power grid technology, and the traditional load feature information is feature extraction and feature mining by simple convolutional neural network due to the inability to effectively combine multiple input timing component information when using CNN for load state identification. For this reason, a load state identification method based on the combination of CNN and Transformer is proposed. CNN mines the features of steady-state load and abnormal operating condition load data. In contrast, Transformer’s multi-attention mechanism is utilized to obtain the effects of abnormal load changes on steady-state load, and simulation and experimental results verify the correctness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Wind Power Curtailment Optimization using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Net-zero emission targets are significantly changing the world’s energy mixes. The increase in wind and solar photovoltaic power plants connected to the electrical grid is a concern for Systems Operators. Wind and solar energy are Renewable Energy Sources (RES) and do not produce greenhouse gases, but they have intrinsic characteristics that make the system operation more complex and dynamic. The Operator must have more flexibility resources available in a network with high intermittency and variability generation to safely deliver energy to consumers. When the system does not have enough flexibility, the Operator has as last step the power curtailment. In many countries, this feature is being widely used due to the rapid deployment of variable renewable energy power plants compared to transmission system expansion and evolution of more ancillary services. These power restrictions may incur additional costs for the generator or the consumer, depending on local regulations, thus substantial reductions are undesirable. To assist in decision-making process of renewable energy cut by System Operators, this paper proposes a methodology to optimize wind energy curtailment, using Genetic Algorithm and considering economic and regulatory aspects.

articleTitle: Research on the Active Power Control Stability of the Renewable Energy Connected to Weak Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method to analyze the stability of grids-connected VSC based on its single-input single-output (SISO) open-loop transfer function model. Unlike the traditional eigenvalue analysis, impedance analysis or complex torque analysis, the transfer function based analysis is applied. And the multi-input multi-output (MIMO) model of grids-connected VSC is derived firstly and simplifies to a SISO model, which yields the open-loop transfer function. Then, the Bode plot and Nyquist curve based stability criterion can be applied to analyze the stability of the weak grids-connected VSC. Impact of the interaction between phase-locked loop and outer loop on system stability is studied by analyzing the phase stability margin of the open-loop transfer function. Finally, the time-domain simulations matches well with the results obtained from the analysis based on Nyquist curve and Bode plot.

articleTitle: Research on Capacity Optimization Configuration of Incremental Distribution Network with Hydrogen Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: The combination of electrolytic hydrogen with wind and photovoltaic power generation has become a trend in the development of power systems. How to effectively allocate wind, solar and hydrogen in the power grid and rationally utilize hydrogen energy storage is an urgent problem that needs to be solved. A capacity optimization configuration method of incremental distribution network with hydrogen energy storage was proposed in this paper. A capacity optimization configuration model is constructed with the goal of optimizing the profits of investors throughout the life cycle. The functions and proportions of hydrogen storage tanks in electricity-hydrogen-electricity conversion were designed. The impact of different ratios of hydrogen storage tanks on capacity optimization configuration was studied. The example study shows that the method proposed in this paper can better take into account optimization configuration requirements such as economic costs, effective utilization of renewable energy, and reliability of energy supply.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Vehicles Charging Network Standards: Study Case in Hainan
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Power and Energy Applications (ICPEA)
abstract: Under the national carbon reduction goals in China, Hainan Province is vigorously promoting the construction of electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure. By 2030, a comprehensive prohibition on the sale of gasoline-powered vehicles will be enforced across the entire island, while EVs are expected to account for over 45% of the total market share. Standards are crucial for the sustainable development of the EV industry. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the current national EV charging network standards, and categorizes them into five aspects including ‘Basic and general’, ‘Planning, design and construction’, ‘Equipment and communications’, ‘Platform’, and ‘Operation’. Furthermore, this paper revisits the relevant work of international committees such as the International organization for Standardization (ISO) and the International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC). From the perspective of the unique characteristics of Hainan’s tropical islands, this paper proposes the standard framework of the Hainan EV charging network, which hopefully can serve as a guiding blueprint for both the immediate and forthcoming standard planning initiatives.
